protocol.hypothesis: After an observable 1W Bollinger-band ZigZag low/high, compare three causal weekly reversal confirmations and three exit rules for long/short entries. A visual bottom label is not a tradable fill.

research_provenance.source: User supplied Trendoscope Band-ZigZag Pine and weekly chart 2026-11-07
research_provenance.note: Imported eta.bb sticky/adaptive internals are unavailable. This experiment explicitly uses standard SMA20 Bollinger bands, population standard deviation and multiplier 2, without sticky/adaptive; it is not an exact test of the original visual script.

protocol.parameter_rationale: Fixed band length 20 and 2 standard deviations so the experiment isolates interaction choices: first rising/falling candle, prior-week high/low break, or two same-direction closes; exit on opposite turn, observed 5% target, or observed 8% target.
protocol.baseline: Same-stock 25%-capital buy-and-hold on the same weekly bars and costs.
protocol.signal_rule: Each completed weekly candle computes Bollinger SMA20 +/- 2 population standard deviations. A high touching upper band creates/replaces a high pivot, a low touching lower creates/replaces a low pivot; candles touching both are ignored as ambiguous. The latest pivot is provisional and may move only going forward. Within eight completed weeks after a low/high, test the chosen reversal confirmation. Enter once per pivot at next weekly open. Exit on opposite signal or, for targets, when completed weekly high/low reaches 5% or 8% from actual next-open entry, filled at the following weekly open; no intrabar target fill. No backdating.
protocol.signal_semantics: Causal weekly Band-ZigZag inspired pivot and post-pivot turn; source-library sticky/adaptive behavior deliberately excluded.
protocol.evaluation_unit: Independent 1m RUB virtual account per symbol; this is not a combined portfolio.
protocol.execution_timing: Observe completed 1W candle; order at next available 1W open. No orders at visually backdated pivot center.
protocol.holding_period: Until opposite signal or next-open execution after weekly target observation.
protocol.rebalance_rule: No intrabar rebalance; at most one position per account.
protocol.availability_lag: A weekly pivot exists at close of its band-touch week; a turn needs at least one subsequent completed week.
protocol.cost_status: after_30bps_round_trip_transaction_cost_equivalent; excludes dividends, short borrow and exchange lots
protocol.selection: Compare all nine preregistered variants against baseline on every eligible TQBR ticker. Review monthly downside and strict >10% latest complete 12-month net gate; do not automatically promote because source parity, corporate actions and independent holdout remain unverified.
limitations: This deterministic adaptation does not reproduce the imported Trendoscope band implementation exactly
Weekly signal fills at next weekly open, not at the bend price

Corporate actions and short borrowing incomplete
